name: Smart Shelf Organizer
persistent_effects: Assigned shelf genres are stored in vanilla shelf save data and remain after uninstall.
The module creates SmartShelfOrganizer/zone_profiles.tsv at runtime; deleting it removes the additional age and critic policies.
install_notes: Development prototype: employee redirection and visual policy tags are disabled.
In-game compatibility and save/reload verification are incomplete; this package is not a public release.
